lead: Glass terrarium measuring 70x45x70 cm. Volume: 220.5 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The height of this terrarium equals its length: 70x45x70 cm, about 220 liters. The floor has 3150 cm². Such proportions give both a serious floor and a lot of space above it, so it can be set up on two levels. It has no 3D background, so the back and sides are covered with film on the outside.

An adult corn snake uses both dimensions: it moves and hides on the floor, and climbs the branches to the top. A ball python accepts low, sturdy branches and a shelf at half height. Height does not mean much to tortoises, but it allows a stronger lamp at a safe distance. For an adult bearded dragon the floor is shorter than the required 100 cm.

If you need the same height with a longer floor, the 80x50x80 model or a custom terrarium is the next choice. If you want a shelf or a different ventilation layout, state that in your inquiry. A custom terrarium like that is ready in 7 to 14 days. Film of your choice goes on the back and sides, and we ship it by courier.
